title: Book One · Chapter 79: The Returned Job
story:
Dad comes home. He says very little.

He puts his blue toolbox under the table. Then he takes it out again and moves it beside the wall. Ronan watches him do this twice.

“Is it in the wrong place?” he asks.

“No. It is all right there.”

Mum gives Dad a bowl of water to wash in. He rolls up his sleeves. His shirt has a dark mark near the elbow.

At supper, he hardly looks at his food.

“Someone brought a job back,” he says at last.

Mum waits. Ronan keeps his spoon still.

“The handle I finished last week. The new part worked loose.”

“Did the thing break?” Ronan asks.

“No one was hurt. I need to fix the handle again.”

Ronan feels a little better. But Dad still looks unhappy.

“Did the man shout?”

“He was angry. He paid for it to work.”

“Perhaps he pulled it too hard.”

Dad looks at him. “We checked. I did not fasten one part properly.”

Dad says he made the mistake, not the owner. Ronan puts his spoon down.

“Will Mr Sun send you away?”

“He did not say that. We must finish this repair first. Then we can accept more jobs like it.”

“Can you use the part again?” Mum asks. Dad says yes. He will use his own time to put it right. They talk in low voices about tomorrow's work. Ronan can hear enough. He does not need every number.

After supper, he takes his class page to the bed. His drawing shows a paper boat. The boat leans to one side. He nearly carries the page to Dad. He wants to tell Dad about his own boat.

Then he stops. A wet paper boat is not the same as a job someone has paid for.

He sits down and finishes the word WIDER.

Dad comes to the bed a few minutes later. He looks quietly at the page.

“We are making another,” Ronan says.

“I see.”

“This corner was too thick.”

Dad points, then takes his finger away. “Did the thick corner make it lean?”

“We saw it lean that way.”

“Then try that part next.”

“Do you want to see my wooden boat?” Ronan asks. Dad shakes his head gently.

“Not tonight. I am tired.”

It hurts a little, even though Dad says it kindly. Ronan puts the school page away. He leaves the wooden boat on the shelf.

Mum asks him to bring the cups. He carries two first, then returns for the third. Mum gives Dad water. He drinks it. She left a piece of fruit on his plate too. After a while he begins to eat it.

Mum sits beside Ronan while Dad washes the bowls. She asks him to clear a space for breakfast. He puts the fruit peels in the kitchen pot and folds the cloth. He can do these three small jobs now. The space grows clear. He feels calmer. Dad brings the dry bowls back. There is still some soap on one bowl. Ronan points it out. Dad washes it again. He does not get angry with Ronan.

Before bed, Dad takes out his work card. He checks the time for the next day. Ronan sees him put it beside the toolbox.

“You are going tomorrow?”

“Yes.”

Ronan nods. He has no way to fix Dad's mistake. Dad still has work at Mr Sun's tomorrow. Ronan is glad he can go back.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达

- worked loose＝变松了
- properly＝正确、妥当地
- put it right＝把它纠正
- return＝返修件

额外情节词（不要求本章全部记住）：fasten＝固定；elbow＝手肘；soap＝肥皂。

## 读句提示

**Can you use the part again?**

你能／再次使用／这个零件吗？直接询问，不用asks whether。

## 理解问题

1. Dad明确承担了哪一项错误？
2. Ronan为什么没有拿自己的纸船错误直接安慰父亲？
